plan.name: Say what retry actually does
plan.summary: Keep retry's modeled behavior unchanged: a failed build with an open pull request watches that request again, while a build that stopped without one builds the ratified proposal again; protocol, recovery, builder outcomes, authorization, action eligibility, legacy failure handling, current-head CI, scope and ratification stay as they are (D-0047, D-0064, D-0105, D-0109, D-0156). Correct the failed plumbing draft post, refused-revise note, CI and other PR-failure advice and retry answer to explain the consequence of watching: once CI's gate passes on the current head and the existing merge safeguards allow it, the factory marks an ordinary draft ready and merges it without another review, even if its earlier review asked for changes, so it merges as-is unless someone pushes those changes; for the trusted base a person merges it, the factory does not mark its draft ready, and neither posts nor cards may claim a rejected review passed (#145, D-0105). Retain the alternative of closing #N, saying 'draft the same plan again', commenting /invariant revise and ratifying the resulting draft before building again, the accurate no-PR build-again advice, the separate CI job-restart instructions without implying retry reruns CI, and statements or proposal terminology for modeled work. Serve waiting.retry with plain-text label, confirmation and guidance only where takes already allows retry, using the acceptance tests' 'Merge #N once CI passes', 'Have a person merge #N once CI passes' and 'Build ratified proposal again' labels and confirmations according to PR presence and known trusted-base evidence (the failure or the proposal's trusted files), retaining the conditional human-merge exception where the marker cannot establish the current head's scope; both public cards and /act render the escaped copy, including a visible label on the public copy-command button, explain the current-head merge and absent review, tell people to push requested fixes before retrying and give the plumbing redraft route, preserve /invariant retry as the command, and describe the same effect in history using the failure that command answered and in both immediate posted displays (the client's posted state and the server's Acted text), keeping queued state and comment links and updating existing wording expectations without weakening clipping, eligibility or feedback checks. Update SPEC.md and README.md to explain build-versus-watch retries, ready-and-merge without another review (including a rejected review's unchanged draft), human-only trusted-base merging, the close/same-plan/revise/ratify route and dashboard wording, qualifying the existing plumbing review-approval description with this retry exception and citing D-0047, D-0064, D-0105, D-0109, D-0156 and D-0122 on the changed SPEC bullets; the merger records the newly selected presentation contract and clarified retry exception through decision tooling because this plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestPlumbingDraftRetryPostsMatchWatching
tests.says: Agent errors, failed tests and rejected reviews leave drafts whose failure and refused-revise posts explain watching, ready-and-merge on current-head CI without another review, and the close/same-plan/revise/ratify alternative; retry still watches that PR without building, and closing and revising waits for ratification.

tests.name: TestRetryPostsDistinguishCIFailureAndStoppedBuild
tests.says: CI-failure advice explains watching the same PR through current-head CI to factory or human merge without another review, preserving merge safeguards; a stopped build without a PR still says build again and rebuilds the same ratified proposal without drafting.

tests.name: TestRejectedReviewRetrySaysAndDoesMergeTheUnchangedDraft
tests.says: A rejected-review draft's retry explicitly warns it can merge as-is unless changes are pushed, then marks the unchanged draft ready and merges it after CI passes, without a new build or review; its trusted-base counterpart stays a draft for a person to merge and never claims the rejected review passed.

tests.name: TestRetryCardsDescribeTheExistingAction
tests.says: The served card contract supplies labels, confirmations and guidance that explain merge after CI with no new review, the trusted-base human merge and the no-PR rebuild, while retaining eligibility, legacy and modeled-project handling and the redraft route.

tests.name: TestPostedRetriesSayWhetherTheyWatchOrBuild
tests.says: Accepted retries post the same command through the owner and agent doors and immediately explain watching through CI to factory or human merge without another review, or building again without a PR, preserving queued state, comment links, refresh behavior and stale-command refusal.

tests.name: TestRetryHistoryExplainsMergeWithoutAnotherReview
tests.says: Retry history uses the failure that the command answered to explain merging the named PR after CI without another review, human merging for the trusted base, or rebuilding without a PR, even after later factory posts.

usage.summary: Revised [plan.json](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-plan-3815204020/plan.json) and acceptance tests to explain merging after CI without another review, including the trusted-base exception. Check passed: all six acceptance tests fail on the base code, and `repo/` remains unchanged.
